entries.name: ConnesRigidity.carry_add_left

entries.statement: ∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] [inst_1 : CompactSpace X] (f : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap X ℝ), (∀ (y : X), 0 ≤ f y) → ConnesRigidity.characterRealComplexification f = star (ConnesRigidity.characterRealComplexification (ConnesRigidity.characterRealSqrt f)) * ConnesRigidity.characterRealComplexification (ConnesRigidity.characterRealSqrt f)

entries.name: ConnesRigidity.characterVectorFunctionalLinear_apply
entries.statement: ∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {V : Type v} [inst_1 : NormedAddCommGroup V] [inst_2 : InnerProductSpace ℂ V] [inst_3 : CompleteSpace V] (calculus : C(X, ℂ) →⋆ₐ[ℂ] V →L[ℂ] V) (x : V) (f : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap X ℝ), (ConnesRigidity.characterVectorFunctionalLinear calculus x) f = (inner ℂ x ((calculus (ConnesRigidity.characterRealComplexification f)) x)).re

entries.name: ConnesRigidity.characterVectorFunctionalLinear_nonneg
entries.statement: ∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {V : Type v} [inst_1 : NormedAddCommGroup V] [inst_2 : InnerProductSpace ℂ V] [inst_3 : CompleteSpace V] [CompactSpace X] (calculus : C(X, ℂ) →⋆ₐ[ℂ] V →L[ℂ] V) (x : V) (f : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap X ℝ), (∀ (y : X), 0 ≤ f y) → 0 ≤ (ConnesRigidity.characterVectorFunctionalLinear calculus x) f

entries.name: ConnesRigidity.characterVectorFunctional_apply
entries.statement: ∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {V : Type v} [inst_1 : NormedAddCommGroup V] [inst_2 : InnerProductSpace ℂ V] [inst_3 : CompleteSpace V] [inst_4 : CompactSpace X] (calculus : C(X, ℂ) →⋆ₐ[ℂ] V →L[ℂ] V) (x : V) (f : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap X ℝ), (ConnesRigidity.characterVectorFunctional calculus x) f = (inner ℂ x ((calculus (ConnesRigidity.characterRealComplexification f)) x)).re

entries.name: ConnesRigidity.characterVectorFunctional_energy_of_operator
entries.statement: ∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {V : Type v} [inst_1 : NormedAddCommGroup V] [inst_2 : InnerProductSpace ℂ V] [inst_3 : CompleteSpace V] [inst_4 : CompactSpace X] (calculus : C(X, ℂ) →⋆ₐ[ℂ] V →L[ℂ] V) (x : V) (f : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap X ℝ) (T : V →L[ℂ] V), calculus (ConnesRigidity.characterRealComplexification f) = star (T - 1) * (T - 1) → (ConnesRigidity.characterVectorFunctional calculus x) f = ‖T x - x‖ ^ 2

entries.name: ConnesRigidity.characterVectorFunctional_one
entries.statement: ∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {V : Type v} [inst_1 : NormedAddCommGroup V] [inst_2 : InnerProductSpace ℂ V] [inst_3 : CompleteSpace V] [inst_4 : CompactSpace X] (calculus : C(X, ℂ) →⋆ₐ[ℂ] V →L[ℂ] V) (x : V) (f : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap X ℝ), (∀ (y : X), f y = 1) → (ConnesRigidity.characterVectorFunctional calculus x) f = ‖x‖ ^ 2

entries.statement: ∀ {V : Type v} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup V] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ V] [inst_2 : CompleteSpace V] {A : Type u} [inst_3 : AddCommGroup A] [inst_4 : TopologicalSpace A] [inst_5 : DiscreteTopology A] (calculus : C(ConnesRigidity.DiscreteCharacterSpace A, ℂ) →⋆ₐ[ℂ] V →L[ℂ] V) (x : V) (a : A) (evaluation : C(ConnesRigidity.DiscreteCharacterSpace A, ℂ)), (∀ (χ : ConnesRigidity.DiscreteCharacterSpace A), evaluation χ = ↑(χ (Multiplicative.ofAdd a))) → ∀ (T : V →L[ℂ] V), calculus evaluation = T → (ConnesRigidity.characterVectorFunctional calculus x) (ConnesRigidity.spectralEnergyTest a) = ‖T x - x‖ ^ 2

entries.name: ConnesRigidity.characterVectorFunctional_spectralUnit
entries.statement: ∀ {V : Type v} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup V] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ V] [inst_2 : CompleteSpace V] {A : Type u} [inst_3 : AddCommGroup A] [inst_4 : TopologicalSpace A] [inst_5 : DiscreteTopology A] (calculus : C(ConnesRigidity.DiscreteCharacterSpace A, ℂ) →⋆ₐ[ℂ] V →L[ℂ] V) (x : V), (ConnesRigidity.characterVectorFunctional calculus x) (ConnesRigidity.spectralUnitTest A) = ‖x‖ ^ 2

entries.name: ConnesRigidity.character_sq
entries.statement: ∀ (M : Type u_1) [inst : AddCommGroup M] [Module ConnesRigidity.F M] [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace M] (χ : PontryaginDual (Multiplicative M)) (x : Multiplicative M), χ x ^ 2 = 1

entries.name: ConnesRigidity.character_truncated_detection_primitive_seventh
entries.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ), 0 < N → ∀ (z : ConnesRigidity.X × ConnesRigidity.Y), (∃ x, z.1 (ConnesRigidity.polynomialVectorVal x) ≠ 0 ∨ z.2 (ConnesRigidity.diagonal (ConnesRigidity.polynomialVectorVal x)) ≠ 0) → (ConnesRigidity.primitiveTruncationFinset N).card ≤ 7 * {x ∈ ConnesRigidity.primitiveTruncationFinset N | z.1 (ConnesRigidity.polynomialVectorVal x) ≠ 0 ∨ z.2 (ConnesRigidity.diagonal (ConnesRigidity.polynomialVectorVal x)) ≠ 0}.card

entries.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (z : ConnesRigidity.X × ConnesRigidity.Y), (∃ x, z.1 (ConnesRigidity.polynomialVectorVal x) ≠ 0 ∨ z.2 (ConnesRigidity.diagonal (ConnesRigidity.polynomialVectorVal x)) ≠ 0) → Fintype.card (ConnesRigidity.BinaryPolynomialVector N) ≤ 4 * {x | z.1 (ConnesRigidity.polynomialVectorVal x) ≠ 0 ∨ z.2 (ConnesRigidity.diagonal (ConnesRigidity.polynomialVectorVal x)) ≠ 0}.card

entries.statement: ∀ {K : Type u} [inst : Group K] {Ω : Type v} [inst_1 : AddCommGroup Ω] [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace Ω] [inst_3 : MeasurableSpace Ω] [inst_4 : CompactSpace Ω] [inst_5 : T2Space Ω] [SecondCountableTopology Ω] [inst_7 : BorelSpace Ω] {ι : Type u_1} (X : ConnesRigidity.HaarProbabilityAction K Ω) [X.measure.WeaklyRegular] (χ : ι → C(Ω, ℂ)), (Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range χ)).topologicalClosure = ⊤ → ∀ (T : ↥(ConnesRigidity.crossedBaseHilbert X) →L[ℂ] ↥(ConnesRigidity.crossedBaseHilbert X)), (∀ (i : ι), Commute T (ConnesRigidity.crossedBaseMultiplier X (ConnesRigidity.crossedContinuousCharacterCoefficient X (χ i)))) → ∀ (f : ↥(ConnesRigidity.crossedCoefficient X)), Commute T (ConnesRigidity.crossedBaseMultiplier X f)

entries.name: ConnesRigidity.kDAction_toAdd
entries.statement: ∀ (k : ↥ConnesRigidity.K) (d : Multiplicative ConnesRigidity.D), Multiplicative.toAdd ((ConnesRigidity.kDAction k) d) = (ConnesRigidity.kDLinear k) (Multiplicative.toAdd d)

entries.name: ConnesRigidity.kDLinear
entries.statement: ↥ConnesRigidity.K →* ConnesRigidity.D ≃ₗ[ConnesRigidity.F] ConnesRigidity.D

entries.name: ConnesRigidity.kDLinear_apply
entries.statement: ∀ (k : ↥ConnesRigidity.K) (d : ConnesRigidity.D), (ConnesRigidity.kDLinear k) d = ((ConnesRigidity.kLinear k) d.1, (ConnesRigidity.kDividedSquareLinear k) d.2)

entries.name: ConnesRigidity.kDLinear_linearDetectorAt
entries.statement: ∀ (k : ↥ConnesRigidity.K) (v : ConnesRigidity.V), (ConnesRigidity.kDLinear k) (ConnesRigidity.linearDetectorAt v) = ConnesRigidity.linearDetectorAt ((ConnesRigidity.kLinear k) v)

entries.name: ConnesRigidity.kDLinear_quadraticDetectorAt
entries.statement: ∀ (k : ↥ConnesRigidity.K) (v : ConnesRigidity.V), (ConnesRigidity.kDLinear k) (ConnesRigidity.quadraticDetectorAt v) = ConnesRigidity.quadraticDetectorAt ((ConnesRigidity.kLinear k) v)

entries.name: ConnesRigidity.kDividedSquareLinear
entries.statement: ↥ConnesRigidity.K →* ↥ConnesRigidity.B ≃ₗ[ConnesRigidity.F] ↥ConnesRigidity.B

entries.name: ConnesRigidity.kDividedSquareLinear_diagonal
entries.statement: ∀ (k : ↥ConnesRigidity.K) (v : ConnesRigidity.V), (ConnesRigidity.kDividedSquareLinear k) (ConnesRigidity.diagonal v) = ConnesRigidity.diagonal ((ConnesRigidity.kLinear k) v)

entries.name: ConnesRigidity.kDividedSquareLinear_polarization
entries.statement: ∀ (k : ↥ConnesRigidity.K) (u v : ConnesRigidity.V), (ConnesRigidity.kDividedSquareLinear k) (ConnesRigidity.polarization u v) = ConnesRigidity.polarization ((ConnesRigidity.kLinear k) u) ((ConnesRigidity.kLinear k) v)

entries.name: ConnesRigidity.kDividedSquareLinear_val
entries.statement: ∀ (k : ↥ConnesRigidity.K) (b : ↥ConnesRigidity.B), ↑((ConnesRigidity.kDividedSquareLinear k) b) = (ConnesRigidity.kTensorLinear k) ↑b

entries.name: ConnesRigidity.kEAction
entries.statement: (n : ℕ) → ↥ConnesRigidity.K →* MulAut (Multiplicative (ConnesRigidity.E n))

entries.name: ConnesRigidity.kEAction_apply
entries.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (k : ↥ConnesRigidity.K) (η : Multiplicative (ConnesRigidity.E n)) (z : Multiplicative (ConnesRigidity.CarryGroup n)), (Additive.toMul (Multiplicative.toAdd (((ConnesRigidity.kEAction n) k) η))) z = (Additive.toMul (Multiplicative.toAdd η)) (((ConnesRigidity.kCarryAction n) k)⁻¹ z)

entries.name: ConnesRigidity.kEAction_iota
entries.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (k : ↥ConnesRigidity.K) (v : ConnesRigidity.V), ((ConnesRigidity.kEAction n) k) (Multiplicative.ofAdd ((ConnesRigidity.iota n) v)) = Multiplicative.ofAdd ((ConnesRigidity.iota n) ((ConnesRigidity.kLinear k) v))

entries.name: ConnesRigidity.kEAddAction
entries.statement: (n : ℕ) → ↥ConnesRigidity.K → ConnesRigidity.E n ≃+ ConnesRigidity.E n

entries.name: ConnesRigidity.kEAddAction_apply
entries.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (k : ↥ConnesRigidity.K) (η : ConnesRigidity.E n), (ConnesRigidity.kEAddAction n k) η = Multiplicative.toAdd (((ConnesRigidity.kEAction n) k) (Multiplicative.ofAdd η))

entries.name: ConnesRigidity.kEAddAction_iota
entries.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (k : ↥ConnesRigidity.K) (v : ConnesRigidity.V), (ConnesRigidity.kEAddAction n k) ((ConnesRigidity.iota n) v) = (ConnesRigidity.iota n) ((ConnesRigidity.kLinear k) v)

entries.name: ConnesRigidity.kEAddAction_iota_orbit_infinite
entries.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (v : ConnesRigidity.V), v ≠ 0 → (Set.range fun k => (ConnesRigidity.kEAddAction n k) ((ConnesRigidity.iota n) v)).Infinite

entries.name: ConnesRigidity.kEAddAction_orbit_infinite_of_exact
entries.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (sigma : ConnesRigidity.E n →+ ↥ConnesRigidity.B), sigma.ker = (ConnesRigidity.iota n).range → (∀ (k : ↥ConnesRigidity.K) (η : ConnesRigidity.E n), sigma ((ConnesRigidity.kEAddAction n k) η) = (ConnesRigidity.kDividedSquareLinear k) (sigma η)) → ∀ (η : ConnesRigidity.E n), η ≠ 0 → (Set.range fun k => (ConnesRigidity.kEAddAction n k) η).Infinite

entries.name: ConnesRigidity.kEAddAction_quadratic_value
entries.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (k : ↥ConnesRigidity.K) (η : ConnesRigidity.E n) (q : ConnesRigidity.Y), (Additive.toMul ((ConnesRigidity.kEAddAction n k) η)) (Multiplicative.ofAdd { linear := 0, quadratic := q }) = (Additive.toMul η) (Multiplicative.ofAdd { linear := 0, quadratic := (ConnesRigidity.kYLinear k⁻¹) q })

entries.statement: ↥ConnesRigidity.K →* ConnesRigidity.V ≃ₗ[ConnesRigidity.F] ConnesRigidity.V

entries.name: ConnesRigidity.kLinear_apply
entries.statement: ∀ (k : ↥ConnesRigidity.K) (v : ConnesRigidity.V), (ConnesRigidity.kLinear k) v = (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.toLin' (ConnesRigidity.pi₂ k)) v

entries.name: ConnesRigidity.kLinear_shiftVector
entries.statement: ∀ (k : ↥ConnesRigidity.K) (n : ℕ) (v : ConnesRigidity.V), (ConnesRigidity.kLinear k) ((ConnesRigidity.shiftVector n) v) = (ConnesRigidity.shiftVector n) ((ConnesRigidity.kLinear k) v)

entries.name: ConnesRigidity.kTensorLinear
entries.statement: ↥ConnesRigidity.K →* ConnesRigidity.T ≃ₗ[ConnesRigidity.F] ConnesRigidity.T

entries.name: ConnesRigidity.kTensorLinear_actingTransvection
entries.statement: ∀ {i j : ConnesRigidity.Index} (hij : i ≠ j) (n : ℕ), ConnesRigidity.kTensorLinear (ConnesRigidity.actingTransvection hij n) = ConnesRigidity.transvectionTensor hij (Polynomial.X ^ n)

entries.name: ConnesRigidity.kTensorLinear_map_B
entries.statement: ∀ (k : ↥ConnesRigidity.K), Submodule.map (↑(ConnesRigidity.kTensorLinear k)) ConnesRigidity.B = ConnesRigidity.B

entries.name: ConnesRigidity.kTensorLinear_square
entries.statement: ∀ (k : ↥ConnesRigidity.K) (v : ConnesRigidity.V), (ConnesRigidity.kTensorLinear k) (ConnesRigidity.square v) = ConnesRigidity.square ((ConnesRigidity.kLinear k) v)

entries.name: ConnesRigidity.kTensorLinear_tmul
entries.statement: ∀ (k : ↥ConnesRigidity.K) (u v : ConnesRigidity.V), (ConnesRigidity.kTensorLinear k) (u ⊗ₜ[ConnesRigidity.F] v) = (ConnesRigidity.kLinear k) u ⊗ₜ[ConnesRigidity.F] (ConnesRigidity.kLinear k) v

entries.name: ConnesRigidity.kXLinear
entries.statement: ↥ConnesRigidity.K →* ConnesRigidity.X ≃ₗ[ConnesRigidity.F] ConnesRigidity.X

entries.name: ConnesRigidity.kXLinear_apply
entries.statement: ∀ (k : ↥ConnesRigidity.K) (ℓ : ConnesRigidity.X) (v : ConnesRigidity.V), ((ConnesRigidity.kXLinear k) ℓ) v = ℓ ((ConnesRigidity.kLinear k⁻¹) v)

entries.name: ConnesRigidity.kXLinear_shift
entries.statement: ∀ (k : ↥ConnesRigidity.K) (n : ℕ) (ℓ : ConnesRigidity.X), (ConnesRigidity.shift n) ((ConnesRigidity.kXLinear k) ℓ) = (ConnesRigidity.kXLinear k) ((ConnesRigidity.shift n) ℓ)

entries.name: ConnesRigidity.kYLinear
entries.statement: ↥ConnesRigidity.K →* ConnesRigidity.Y ≃ₗ[ConnesRigidity.F] ConnesRigidity.Y

entries.name: ConnesRigidity.kYLinear_apply
entries.statement: ∀ (k : ↥ConnesRigidity.K) (q : ConnesRigidity.Y) (b : ↥ConnesRigidity.B), ((ConnesRigidity.kYLinear k) q) b = q ((ConnesRigidity.kDividedSquareLinear k⁻¹) b)

entries.name: ConnesRigidity.kYLinear_carry
entries.statement: ∀ (k : ↥ConnesRigidity.K) (ℓ ℓ' : ConnesRigidity.X), (ConnesRigidity.kYLinear k) (ConnesRigidity.carry ℓ ℓ') = ConnesRigidity.carry ((ConnesRigidity.kXLinear k) ℓ) ((ConnesRigidity.kXLinear k) ℓ')

entries.name: ConnesRigidity.kYLinear_shiftedCarry
entries.statement: ∀ (k : ↥ConnesRigidity.K) (n : ℕ) (ℓ ℓ' : ConnesRigidity.X), (ConnesRigidity.kYLinear k) (ConnesRigidity.shiftedCarry n ℓ ℓ') = ConnesRigidity.shiftedCarry n ((ConnesRigidity.kXLinear k) ℓ) ((ConnesRigidity.kXLinear k) ℓ')

entries.name: ConnesRigidity.k_D_orbit_infinite
entries.statement: ∀ (x : ConnesRigidity.D), x ≠ 0 → (Set.range fun k => (ConnesRigidity.kDLinear k) x).Infinite

entries.name: ConnesRigidity.k_dividedSquare_orbit_infinite
entries.statement: ∀ (b : ↥ConnesRigidity.B), b ≠ 0 → (Set.range fun k => (ConnesRigidity.kDividedSquareLinear k) b).Infinite

entries.name: ConnesRigidity.k_tensor_orbit_infinite

entries.name: ConnesRigidity.kernelCharacter
entries.statement: (n : ℕ) → (η : ConnesRigidity.E n) → (ConnesRigidity.quadraticRestriction n) η = 0 → PontryaginDual (Multiplicative ConnesRigidity.X)

entries.name: ConnesRigidity.kernelCharacter_apply
entries.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (η : ConnesRigidity.E n) (h : (ConnesRigidity.quadraticRestriction n) η = 0) (ℓ : ConnesRigidity.X), (ConnesRigidity.kernelCharacter n η h) (Multiplicative.ofAdd ℓ) = ConnesRigidity.evalEta η (ConnesRigidity.linearSection n ℓ)

entries.statement: {A : Type u} → [inst : AddCommGroup A] → {G H : ConnesRigidity.CountableDiscreteGroup} → {V : Type u} → [inst_1 : NormedAddCommGroup V] → [inst_2 : InnerProductSpace ℂ V] → [inst_3 : CompleteSpace V] → ConnesRigidity.SplitAbelianExtension A G H → ConnesRigidity.UnitaryRepresentation G.Carrier V → V → Set V

entries.name: ConnesRigidity.kernelOrbit_closedConvexHull_projection_eq_zero
entries.statement: ∀ {A : Type u} [inst : AddCommGroup A] {G H : ConnesRigidity.CountableDiscreteGroup} (E : ConnesRigidity.SplitAbelianExtension A G H) {V : Type u} [inst_1 : NormedAddCommGroup V] [inst_2 : InnerProductSpace ℂ V] [inst_3 : CompleteSpace V] (π : ConnesRigidity.UnitaryRepresentation G.Carrier V) (x : V), (ConnesRigidity.trivialCharacterProjection E π) x = 0 → ∀ y ∈ (closedConvexHull ℝ) (Set.range fun a => ↑(π (E.inclusion (Multiplicative.ofAdd a))) x), (ConnesRigidity.trivialCharacterProjection E π) y = 0

entries.name: ConnesRigidity.kernelOrbit_exists_finset_affineCombination_norm_lt
entries.statement: ∀ {A : Type u} [inst : AddCommGroup A] {G H : ConnesRigidity.CountableDiscreteGroup} (E : ConnesRigidity.SplitAbelianExtension A G H) {V : Type u} [inst_1 : NormedAddCommGroup V] [inst_2 : InnerProductSpace ℂ V] [inst_3 : CompleteSpace V] (π : ConnesRigidity.UnitaryRepresentation G.Carrier V) (x : V), 0 ∈ (closedConvexHull ℝ) (Set.range fun a => ↑(π (E.inclusion (Multiplicative.ofAdd a))) x) → ∀ {ε : ℝ}, 0 < ε → ∃ s w, (∀ a ∈ s, 0 ≤ w a) ∧ ∑ a ∈ s, w a = 1 ∧ ‖∑ a ∈ s, w a • ↑(π (E.inclusion (Multiplicative.ofAdd a))) x‖ < ε

entries.name: ConnesRigidity.kernelProjectionContinuous_apply
entries.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (z : ConnesRigidity.CarryGroup n), (ConnesRigidity.kernelProjectionContinuous n) (Multiplicative.ofAdd z) = Multiplicative.ofAdd ((ConnesRigidity.kernelProjection n) z)

entries.name: ConnesRigidity.kernelProjectionContinuous_inclusion_apply
entries.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (ℓ : Multiplicative ↥(ConnesRigidity.shiftKernel n)), (ConnesRigidity.kernelProjectionContinuous n) ((ConnesRigidity.shiftKernelInclusionContinuous n) ℓ) = ℓ

entries.name: ConnesRigidity.kernelProjection_apply_coe
entries.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (z : ConnesRigidity.CarryGroup n), ↑((ConnesRigidity.kernelProjection n) z) = z.linear - (ConnesRigidity.shiftSection n) ((ConnesRigidity.shift n) z.linear)

entries.name: ConnesRigidity.kernelProjection_carryPullbackSection
entries.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (z : ConnesRigidity.CarryGroup 0), (ConnesRigidity.kernelProjection n) ((ConnesRigidity.carryPullbackSection n) z) = 0

entries.statement: ∀ {A : Type u} [inst : AddCommGroup A] {G H : ConnesRigidity.CountableDiscreteGroup} {V : Type u} [inst_1 : NormedAddCommGroup V] [inst_2 : InnerProductSpace ℂ V] [inst_3 : CompleteSpace V] (E : ConnesRigidity.SplitAbelianExtension A G H) (π : ConnesRigidity.UnitaryRepresentation G.Carrier V) (x : V) (a : A), ∀ y ∈ ConnesRigidity.kernelOrbitClosedConvexHull E π x, ↑(π (E.inclusion (Multiplicative.ofAdd a))) y ∈ ConnesRigidity.kernelOrbitClosedConvexHull E π x

entries.name: ConnesRigidity.kernel_fixed_eq_zero_of_mem_closedConvexHull
entries.statement: ∀ {A : Type u} [inst : AddCommGroup A] {G H : ConnesRigidity.CountableDiscreteGroup} (E : ConnesRigidity.SplitAbelianExtension A G H) {V : Type u} [inst_1 : NormedAddCommGroup V] [inst_2 : InnerProductSpace ℂ V] [inst_3 : CompleteSpace V] (π : ConnesRigidity.UnitaryRepresentation G.Carrier V) (x v : V), (ConnesRigidity.trivialCharacterProjection E π) x = 0 → v ∈ (closedConvexHull ℝ) (Set.range fun a => ↑(π (E.inclusion (Multiplicative.ofAdd a))) x) → (∀ (a : A), ↑(π (E.inclusion (Multiplicative.ofAdd a))) v = v) → v = 0

entries.name: ConnesRigidity.kernel_fixed_inner_eq_zero_of_mem_closedConvexHull
entries.statement: ∀ {A : Type u} [inst : AddCommGroup A] {G H : ConnesRigidity.CountableDiscreteGroup} (E : ConnesRigidity.SplitAbelianExtension A G H) {V : Type u} [inst_1 : NormedAddCommGroup V] [inst_2 : InnerProductSpace ℂ V] [inst_3 : CompleteSpace V] (π : ConnesRigidity.UnitaryRepresentation G.Carrier V) (x v y : V), (ConnesRigidity.trivialCharacterProjection E π) x = 0 → (∀ (a : A), ↑(π (E.inclusion (Multiplicative.ofAdd a))) v = v) → y ∈ (closedConvexHull ℝ) (Set.range fun a => ↑(π (E.inclusion (Multiplicative.ofAdd a))) x) → inner ℂ v y = 0

entries.statement: ∀ {A : Type u} [inst : AddCommGroup A] {G H : ConnesRigidity.CountableDiscreteGroup} (E : ConnesRigidity.SplitAbelianExtension A G H) {V : Type u} [inst_1 : NormedAddCommGroup V] [inst_2 : InnerProductSpace ℂ V] [inst_3 : CompleteSpace V] (π : ConnesRigidity.UnitaryRepresentation G.Carrier V) (a : A), Submodule.map (↑(Unitary.linearIsometryEquiv (π (E.inclusion (Multiplicative.ofAdd a)))).toLinearEquiv) (ConnesRigidity.kernelFixedSubmodule E π) = ConnesRigidity.kernelFixedSubmodule E π

entries.name: ConnesRigidity.kernel_orbit_sub_norm
entries.statement: ∀ {A : Type u} [inst : AddCommGroup A] {G H : ConnesRigidity.CountableDiscreteGroup} {W : Type u} [inst_1 : NormedAddCommGroup W] [inst_2 : InnerProductSpace ℂ W] [inst_3 : CompleteSpace W] (E : ConnesRigidity.SplitAbelianExtension A G H) (π : ConnesRigidity.UnitaryRepresentation G.Carrier W) (x : W) (a b : A), ‖↑(π (E.inclusion (Multiplicative.ofAdd a))) x - ↑(π (E.inclusion (Multiplicative.ofAdd b))) x‖ = ‖↑(π (E.inclusion (Multiplicative.ofAdd (a - b)))) x - x‖

entries.name: ConnesRigidity.kernel_orbit_sub_norm_sq
entries.statement: ∀ {A : Type u} [inst : AddCommGroup A] {G H : ConnesRigidity.CountableDiscreteGroup} {W : Type u} [inst_1 : NormedAddCommGroup W] [inst_2 : InnerProductSpace ℂ W] [inst_3 : CompleteSpace W] (E : ConnesRigidity.SplitAbelianExtension A G H) (π : ConnesRigidity.UnitaryRepresentation G.Carrier W) (x : W) (a b : A), ‖↑(π (E.inclusion (Multiplicative.ofAdd a))) x - ↑(π (E.inclusion (Multiplicative.ofAdd b))) x‖ ^ 2 = ‖↑(π (E.inclusion (Multiplicative.ofAdd (a - b)))) x - x‖ ^ 2

entries.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u} {κ : Type v} (ξ : ↥(ConnesRigidity.GroupL2 (ι × κ))) (i : ι) (k : κ), ↑(↑((ConnesRigidity.l2Curry ι κ) ξ) i) k = ↑ξ (i, k)

entries.statement: ∀ {α : Type u} {β : Type v} (e : α ≃ β), (ConnesRigidity.l2Reindex e).symm = ConnesRigidity.l2Reindex e.symm

entries.name: ConnesRigidity.spectralArgCoordinates_dualCharacterAction_sneg
entries.statement: ∀ {A : Type u} [inst : AddCommGroup A] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace A] [inst_2 : DiscreteTopology A] {H : ConnesRigidity.CountableDiscreteGroup} (action : H.Carrier →* Multiplicative (AddAut A)) (h : H.Carrier) (a b : A), (Multiplicative.toAdd (action h⁻¹)) a = a + b → (Multiplicative.toAdd (action h⁻¹)) b = b → ∀ χ ∈ ConnesRigidity.spectralTorusWindow a b, ConnesRigidity.spectralArgCoordinates a b (ConnesRigidity.dualCharacterAction action h χ) = ConnesRigidity.shalomSneg (ConnesRigidity.spectralArgCoordinates a b χ)

entries.statement: ∀ {A : Type u} [inst : AddCommGroup A] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace A] [inst_2 : DiscreteTopology A] {H : ConnesRigidity.CountableDiscreteGroup} (action : H.Carrier →* Multiplicative (AddAut A)) (h : H.Carrier) (a b : A), (Multiplicative.toAdd (action h⁻¹)) a = a - b → (Multiplicative.toAdd (action h⁻¹)) b = b → ∀ χ ∈ ConnesRigidity.spectralTorusWindow a b, ConnesRigidity.spectralArgCoordinates a b (ConnesRigidity.dualCharacterAction action h χ) = ConnesRigidity.shalomSpos (ConnesRigidity.spectralArgCoordinates a b χ)

entries.statement: ∀ {A : Type u} [inst : AddCommGroup A] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace A] [inst_2 : DiscreteTopology A] {H : ConnesRigidity.CountableDiscreteGroup} (action : H.Carrier →* Multiplicative (AddAut A)) (h : H.Carrier) (a b : A), (Multiplicative.toAdd (action h⁻¹)) a = a → (Multiplicative.toAdd (action h⁻¹)) b = b - a → ∀ χ ∈ ConnesRigidity.spectralTorusWindow a b, ConnesRigidity.spectralArgCoordinates a b (ConnesRigidity.dualCharacterAction action h χ) = ConnesRigidity.shalomTpos (ConnesRigidity.spectralArgCoordinates a b χ)

entries.name: ConnesRigidity.spectralArgCoordinates_sneg
entries.statement: ∀ {A : Type u} [inst : AddCommGroup A] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace A] (a b : A), ∀ χ ∈ ConnesRigidity.spectralTorusWindow a b, ConnesRigidity.spectralArgCoordinates (a + b) b χ = ((ConnesRigidity.spectralArgCoordinates a b χ).1 + (ConnesRigidity.spectralArgCoordinates a b χ).2, (ConnesRigidity.spectralArgCoordinates a b χ).2)

entries.statement: ∀ {A : Type u} [inst : AddCommGroup A] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace A] (a b : A), ∀ χ ∈ ConnesRigidity.spectralTorusWindow a b, ConnesRigidity.spectralArgCoordinates a (b + a) χ = ((ConnesRigidity.spectralArgCoordinates a b χ).1, (ConnesRigidity.spectralArgCoordinates a b χ).2 + (ConnesRigidity.spectralArgCoordinates a b χ).1)

entries.statement: ∀ {A : Type u} [inst : AddCommGroup A] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace A] (a b : A), ∀ χ ∈ ConnesRigidity.spectralTorusWindow a b, ConnesRigidity.spectralArgCoordinates a (b - a) χ = ((ConnesRigidity.spectralArgCoordinates a b χ).1, (ConnesRigidity.spectralArgCoordinates a b χ).2 - (ConnesRigidity.spectralArgCoordinates a b χ).1)

entries.statement: ∀ {A : Type u} [inst : AddCommGroup A] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace A] (a b : A), ∀ χ ∈ ConnesRigidity.spectralTorusWindow a b, (↑(χ (Multiplicative.ofAdd (a - b)))).arg = (ConnesRigidity.spectralArgCoordinates a b χ).1 - (ConnesRigidity.spectralArgCoordinates a b χ).2
